symptom: Mid-anchor guarded PPO smoke requested 512 timesteps but stopped after the first 256-timestep chunk because anchor validation guard failed: validation mean KL was 2.310775 above the 0.25 threshold and validation argmax agreement was 0.0 below the 0.85 threshold.

fix: Do not continue this branch. Before another PPO continuation, pre-check start-model alignment on the drift rows, mix the top drift rows with broader opening/mid/late anchor data, or reduce the PPO update size while keeping anchor validation guard and fixed-window no-regression checks.
